what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1980?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1980 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (140 pages) was searched for wage, gross, salary and payroll and found only aggregates and lines (p43 `Special Details - Wages`, p46 `Special Details - Wages 32,051.70`, p58-65 accountant lines) and the school personnel listing (p115-121), which names staff with a start date and prints no pay (sources/data/report-tables/1980/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1980 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1981?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1980 annual town report records the articles (p22, the Personnel Committee: `The Salary Schedule was also revised, not only by a cost-of-living increase, but also by a streamlining of the schedule`; p79 Article 5, which substitutes `the Classification and Salary Schedule proposed by the Personnel Committee and appearing in the report of the Finance Committee`) and not the schedule; searched for classification, salary schedule, step and grade (sources/data/report-tables/1980/). — closes: the Personnel Committee's Classification and Salary Schedule in the Finance Committee's report to the April 5, 1980 Annual Town Meeting.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1980, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1980 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as lines of the general fund balance sheet (p50 `Revolving Funds: School Lunch 6,757.57, School Athletics 654.02`), and the School Department's own special accounts with balance on hand and spent (p133-136); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched revolving and special revenue: the only hits are p50 and p135 (sources/data/report-tables/1980/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1980 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1980?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1980 report prints no such schedule: its balance sheet carries current-year appropriation balances by article (p49) and the accountant's schedule lists each article (p56-66), so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown. Searched capital project, capital plan and capital improvement: p7 (prose) and p84 (a warrant article, `capital improvements ... at the Elementary and High School`, $1,985,048) only (sources/data/report-tables/1980/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1980 capital projects fund ledger.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1981?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation and tax history from the 2000-2010 reports. The 1980 report prints the tax rate in prose (p8: a new rate of $54.00 per thousand after a 10% across-the-board increase in assessed valuation), a six-year recapitulation of the amount raised by taxation (p38, landed as `raised-by-taxation-five-year`) and overlay as balance-sheet reserves (p50); no valuation by property class and no new growth schedule. Searched valuation, assessed, overlay, recapitulation, new growth (sources/data/report-tables/1980/). — closes: the Board of Assessors' fiscal 1981 tax rate recapitulation (DOR form LA-5).

what: What did sealing bring in by device in 1980, and how much did each kind of device cost the Town to test?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1980 report prints the Inspector of Weights and Measures' work only in prose (p25: 38 gasoline pumps tested, 4 adjusted, all sealed; 34 scales checked and sealed, 2 adjusted) and a receipt line (p42); no table of devices and fees. Searched sealer, sealing and weights and measures across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1980/). — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1980 report to the Town with its fee schedule.

what: What did the Town hold in cash each month of fiscal 1980, and how much of it was invested?
why: `report-cash-management` holds the State-required monthly cash management chart from the 1981 report. The 1980 report prints no chart: it discusses cash management in the Treasurer's prose (p36-37: `on average Lunenburg invests 102% of its idle cash`) and prints the half-year investment recapitulation (p71, with per-bank detail stacked in cells and not landed) and the month-end figure only at the close (p38). Searched cash management, month-end and monthly across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1980/). — closes: the Treasurer's State cash management report for fiscal 1980.
